verdict.rationale: LlamaParse documents an async job model with webhook notifications on completion or failure (docs-6), which fits batch pipelines better than polling. Self-hosted Kubernetes/Helm deployment (docs-28) suggests capacity can be scaled under your own control. Nothing in the pack documents rate limits, batch endpoints or throughput, which are the core of this story. Missing for 10: documented rate limits/quotas, a batch submission API, published throughput or SLA figures, and independent evidence of million-page-scale runs.
